turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail:
there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
We offer expedited domestic shipping for an additional fee at checkout, but it doesn’t shorten processing time. Since you’ve already placed your order, expedited shipping can’t be added to it. If it hasn’t been packed, you may request cancellation and place a new order with expedited shipping; once it has shipped, the shipping speed can’t be changed.
If you sign in, I can check your order’s status so you know which options may still be available.
